notes: «حدثنا الشيخ الفقيه أبو جعفر محمد بن علي ... القمي» is the compiler himself: left out, the tool adds him.
The second «أبي» (father of Ahmad b. Abi Abdullah) and the first are both relation links; «آبائه» is a plural relation, not a named person.
The Imam «الصادق جعفر بن محمد» is inside the chain after «عن»: narrator.
